text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival! A day for the Umamusume to show 
their gratitude to the fans who support 
them day in and day out—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —...Or so it was supposed to be.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Let us offer our gratitude to Lady 
Orfevre...!"

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Orfevre! Thank you so much for 
existing!!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Handle it as you see fit.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fans
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaaa...! Thank you so much!!
choice_data_list:
(The event's purpose has been completely 
reversed...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the fans are happy, so maybe this 
is just fine for Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...I have grown weary of this.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I've shown my face. We're done here.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaah! It's the "Emperor"!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Behold, Lady Teio is here♪ Let 
me hear you cheer louder!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: —Ah! Over there too! Another "King"!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahahaha!! As radiant as ever today!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Aah-hah-hah-hah!! Today I'm just as 
upright and proper as ever!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahaha! Bwahahahahahahahaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, those girls... have 
"King" in their names, don't they? Well, 
in a way... they are kings, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hey, gather those up.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I've changed my mind. —I shall teach you 
what it truly means to be a king."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"And that is why! We're having the 
'Determine the True Monarch! The Ultimate 
Battle of Kings'!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I am your commentator, Kawakami Princess, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Brought to you by Fine Motion♪ Things have 
gotten pretty interesting~.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Umm... and how do we determine the true 
king, then?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Proving that you're a wise ruler is 
difficult... Do they judge your demeanor 
during ceremonies, manners, and such?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's completely wrong-desu wa!! It's not 
like that at all! When you think of a 
king, obviously—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: The title of the strongest! And so—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Show your strength to the fans, and 
whichever Uma Musume wins over the hearts 
of the most devotees wins! She shall 
become the true ruler~!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: First to strike wins!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
My power is... speed, of course!! 
HAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone-san rockets down the 
straightaway... and pulls further and 
further out of sight! A power that 
outpaces everyone...—Wait, you've gone too 
far!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Chowaaah!? They got ahead of me!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
HEEEEY!! Taking the lead is the class 
rep's job, you knowww!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, she's so fast! With Bakushin O, 
you can really feel the power of her 
pride. The two of them are similar, but 
definitely different~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it, but... I'm the one 
who's gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! You all know what I'm capable 
of, right~?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm strong, fast, and super cool! 
—Everyone loves me, right?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, the fans are thrilled! That must be 
the power of captivating the masses...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Aah-hah-hah-hah!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, it is time for the opera! Won't you 
sing with me~? ♪ 'O~ sole~ ♪'

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Um...? For now, I guess I'll just clap 
along...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-chan is so glamorous, isn't she?♪ 
Her ability to draw people in is truly 
second to none!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now, as for the heavy favorite! Where is 
Orfevre-san—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?! There ain't no one here, desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —I've grown tired of this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After searching all over, it turned out 
Orfevre was taking a full-on rest.
choice_data_list:
Even though I was the one who suggested 
it...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. It's your own fault for failing to 
pique my interest.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I am retiring for the night. You are to 
clean up after this."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, I ended up struggling tooth and 
nail to somehow bring the chaotic 
tournament to an orderly finish...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Is that all you have? Don't make me laugh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Demonstrate my strength? There is no need 
for that.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —You lot.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Look upward.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
W-Where is this place...?! When did I end 
up in a royal palace...?!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —You hold your head rather high.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: In whose presence do you think you stand?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Kneel.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: This is the answer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The venue falls into absolute silence. 
The spectators are all utterly overwhelmed 
by the sheer power of Orfevre's presence.
